name: Handyman
desc:
A complete remake of this game is in the works. Stay tuned.

Compatible with PC, Mobile, and Console.

A mixture of Human: Fall Flat, VR, Totally Reliable Delivery Service, and Gang Beasts; currently just a testing place.

Use "/votekick username" to votekick a player.
